description_en: Verifies three elements (name, phone number, and ID card number). Compares whether the name, phone number, and ID card number provided by a user belong to the same person
description_zh: 三要素（姓名、手机号和身份证号）核验。用于比对用户填写的姓名、手机号、身份证号三个信息是否属于同一用户
kebab_example: aliyun dytnsapi three-elements-verification --auth-code 'QASDW@#00' --input-number 13900000000 --mask MD5 --cert-code 83d8040d3cb2181e040000dc6ff5566d4493876a4a5da782887446356b0a787e --name '阿里云' --api-version 2020-02-17 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ThreeElementsVerification

parameters.help_en:

parameters.help_en:
The phone number to be verified.

If Mask is set to NORMAL, this field is in plaintext.
If Mask is set to MD5, apply MD5 encryption to this field.
If Mask is set to SHA256, apply SHA256 encryption to this field.

<notice>Letters in the encrypted string are case-insensitive.></notice>
parameters.help_zh:
待检验的号码。

若Mask取值为NORMAL，该字段为明文。
若Mask取值为MD5，请将该字段做MD5加密。
若Mask取值为SHA256，请将该字段做SHA256加密。

<notice>加密字符串中字母不区分大小写。></notice>

Code.description_en:
The request status code.

OK: The request is successful.
For other error codes, see the error code table in this topic.
RequestFrequencyLimit: Due to carrier restrictions, repeated high-frequency queries on the same number within a short period are prohibited. If this error code is returned, try again later

IsConsistent.description_en:
Indicates whether the verification result is consistent. Valid values:

1: Consistent.
0: Inconsistent.
2: No record found.
The data update timeliness varies by carrier and city, typically ranging from T+1 to T+3.
The verification results for different carrier phone numbers in different states are as follows: 

|Carrier/Phone number status|Suspended|Empty number|Canceled|
|--|--|--|--|
|China Mobile|Normal verification|No record found|No record found|
|China Unicom|Normal verification|Inconsistent|Inconsistent|
|China Telecom|Normal verification|No record found|No record found|
IsConsistent.description_zh:
验证结果是否一致。返回：

1：一致
0：不一致
2：查无
不同运营商、不同城市的数据更新时效，通常在T+1至T+3之间。
不同的运营商手机号，在不同状态下，核验结果如下： 

|运营商/手机号状态|停机|空号|销号|
|--|--|--|--|
|中国移动|正常核验|查无|查无|
|中国联通|正常核验|不一致|不一致|
|中国电信|正常核验|查无|查无|
